page.overview:
Who is "Blow the Horn" Kid?

While Homer and Bart were driving a truck, Homer noticed a small boy in the car in front of them. The boy was looking at Homer and moving his arm up and down.

Homer got angry and wanted to teach him a lesson, but Bart then explained to him that the boy only wanted Homer to blow the horn. Homer pulled a cord and released a trailer. In "Lisa the Vegetarian", he was seen in Ms. Hoover's class, which means he's a second grader.

His hair color has changed a number of times. His hair is usually dark brown or black, but in Maximum Homerdrive his hair was orange.
